name: 74-outline
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 16px; } .solid { width: 220px; margin: 28px 0 0 24px; padding: 6px 8px; line-height: 1.45; background: #fff8e8; border: 2px solid #8b6b3d; outline: 4px solid #c0392b; outline-offset: 7px; } .dashed { width: 220px; margin: 42px 0 0 24px; padding: 6px 8px; line-height: 1.45; background: #eef6ff; border: 2px solid #376a9f; border-radius: 10px; outline: 3px dashed #1f6f4a; outline-offset: 3px; outline-color: #145c3a; }
html:
outline 实线：不占盒模型，沿边框外侧绘制，并保留 outline-offset 间距。
outline 虚线长属性：颜色被 outline-color 覆盖，圆角容器外轮廓随圆角扩展。
